rows.General Assumptions: Place any additional orders that are put before 5 pm put together on the original order and any extras after tht 5pm cut off go on a separate order .
if a customer places an add on to just create a new order rather than adjusting the original
Just a friendly reminder to ensure the reports are sent only after all orders are entered for the evening.
Foodbomb/Foodbyus cut off time until 11pm after transfering all orders you can download the reports AS and FR.
Daniella Maunsel is a home delivery customer. She has a profile with us so when you enter her order you can look up her name.
If the customers add any item through email please do not add to their existing orders unless sent on the same time range.
If the customer doesn't say Carrots (Pre-pack) please put it under Carrots - A Grade
If someone asks for pears please put it under Packham Pears
If the customers didn't ask for Mushrooms - Field / Flat (B-Grade) put it under Mushrooms - Field / Flat
Kumera is also known as sweet potato, so if a customer orders sweet potato peeled and diced then that is also the same as kumera peeled and diced.
Whenever Oranges are order by the kg or by piece unless stated as juicing please put it under  a "Garnish" Orange.
Green Apples or even just Apples that are ordered by the carton or box unless otherwise stated is generally juicing apple [FF6]
From now on if an item is not listed please put it under a miscellaneous product with description in notes.
Please be aware that this doesn't include certain notes on products such as, plums central park, should still be put in as plums with central park in the notes.
Regarding the young garlic this is not the same as peeled garlic and should of been put under a miscellaneous product (however we will be adding this on as a new product).
For Bullhorn pepper use Chillies - Banana Peppers Red (for selected customers)
"Sliced" red or white cabbage use red or green cabbage (Shredded)
Red apple use Apple Royal Gala
If they order rocket in bunch use Rocket - Large/Broad Leaf.
For cucumber always base on the qty given.
